text: xi Although they lived through the same crucial historical period and were both fathers of the Reformation, unlike Martin Luther, John Calvin did not leave behind a church named after him.
text_raw:
xi
 Although they lived through the same crucial historical period and were both 
fathers of the Reformation, unlike Martin Luther, John Calvin did not leave 
behind a church named after him.

text: But he did create and shape the other main branch of Protestantism, the Reformed Church, including the Dutch Re- formed Church, the Church of Scotland, and numerous other branches with varying names in various places, including England, Switzerland, Hungary, and especially the United States (where it is often called Presbyterian).
text_raw:
But he did create and shape the other main 
branch of Protestantism, the Reformed Church, including the Dutch Re-
formed Church, the Church of Scotland, and numerous other branches with 
varying names in various places, including England, Switzerland, Hungary, 
and especially the United States (where it is often called Presbyterian).

text: More- over, Calvinâ€™s legacy spread much wider, obviously first and foremost in the religious field, and it also had political, economic, and social impacts that are still with us today; indeed, more with us than ever, half a millennium after his death.
text_raw:
More-
over, Calvinâ€™s legacy spread much wider, obviously first and foremost in the 
religious field, and it also had political, economic, and social impacts that are 
still with us today; indeed, more with us than ever, half a millennium after his 
death.

text: In religion, there are not only Calvinists but Neo-Calvinists of different shapes and forms and, more generally, agreement that people should be free to choose their religion.
text_raw:
In religion, there are not only Calvinists but Neo-Calvinists of different 
shapes and forms and, more generally, agreement that people should be free 
to choose their religion.

text: And we are living in a contemporary world shaped by certain features Calvin strongly influenced, such as the right to indepen- dence, democracy and self-government; the separation of church and state; and a free enterprise economy propelled by banking, among other things.
text_raw:
And we are living in a contemporary world shaped 
by certain features Calvin strongly influenced, such as the right to indepen-
dence, democracy and self-government; the separation of church and state; 
and a free enterprise economy propelled by banking, among other things.

text: So Calvin and Calvinism are of interest to a very broad range of people around the world, although some of them are not that familiar with his name.
